verdict.rationale: Rollbar offers rule-like automation via custom fingerprinting rules, webhooks that can push data to any external service, and integrations (Slack, PagerDuty) triggered by events, plus an AI 'Resolve' agent that automatically generates a PR from a production error. These show event-triggered actions but there's no documented general-purpose rule builder (condition->action) beyond grouping/notification routing, and no evidence of user-defined multi-step automation logic. Missing for 10: a dedicated rules/automation engine UI, examples of custom condition-based triggers beyond notifications, and independent confirmation of the Resolve agent's automatic triggering behavior.
